assumption: For review only, assume declared model runs and human collection were completed competently and could populate reserved tables. Do not penalize absent measured values, but do not assume favorable performance, human-visible uniqueness, successful qualification, agreement, superiority, an integration deficit, ranking changes, or significance. Construction, semantic scoring, estimand definitions, and executable analysis remain in scope. No actual model or human collection is asserted.

scientific_contribution.assessment: The new visual-to-graph repair family is a genuine narrow composition resource, not a relabeling of the old atomic benchmark. Crossed binding/fault interventions and complete optimal-set semantics distinguish its contract from the checked closest work. The interface readout must be completed to make the central contribution effective.

construct_validity.assessment: Binding and structural inputs each have certified consequences for complete solution sets; matched preserving controls are implemented. The supplied graph is explicit and the paper avoids hidden-topology, hard-vision, and physical-repair claims. The current marginal summaries do not identify joint-condition failure on the same isolated-competence items.

dataset_depth_diversity_dependence.assessment: The census, exclusions, pre-search grouping, disjoint selected instances and held-out source/design/template checks are implemented. There are 84 constructions from 17 sources, with 57 held-out constructions in ten groups. The unattained precision target and finite-resource restriction are explicit; observation multiplicity is not claimed as independent diversity.

ground_truth_scoring_shortcuts.assessment: Independent union-find scoring correctly checks all optima, components, binding, membership, duplicates, costs and budgets in the focused audit. Matched pixel controls pass. Legal silhouette plus exact search achieves 624/684 held-out repairs, 91.23% micro and 78.29% group macro; the fired gate and narrowed interpretation are retained.

experiment_design_uncertainty.assessment: The four matched conditions can support an interface study, but the analyzer lacks task-aligned atomic/oracle/multimodal joint outcomes, implemented cross-condition paired contrasts, and qualification-derived subset reporting. Identical existing summaries can conceal opposite joint-condition failure rates. This is not a penalty for blank tables.
evidence: Reviewer in-memory aligned/disjoint synthetic outcome counterexample

reproducibility_figures_geometry.assessment: Native byte hashes, study source locks, source mesh and induced-graph checks, semantic receipt validation and figure provenance are strong. The portable adapter keeps the declared native information boundary. Nonzero exits and timeouts lose available raw diagnostics; qualification is not yet joined into analysis.

presentation_cvpr_readiness.assessment: The main PDF has six content pages and a separate reference page; the supplement has six pages. Both main figures now show the actual primary task with evaluator GT and source context explicitly separated from model input. The embedded labels in the factorial figure remain small at print size.

issues.summary: The former atomic-core objection is closed by the actual visually bound minimum-terminal-repair family, under its narrow declared scope.

evidence.finding: Implements 84 constructions with visually selected third terminals and complete minimum-restoration outputs. Visual and structural changes require disjoint complete optimal-set families, not merely different serialization.
Independent read-only execution reproduced all 1008 semantic answers and dependency/equivariance checks.
The new primary family and closest-work distinction are explicit. It claims a controlled binding/optimization interface, not a new graph algorithm, hard perception, or physical repair.

issues.why_it_matters: There is now an actual visual dependency and a substantive structural output in the primary task. Binding alone cannot enumerate the repairs and the graph alone does not supply the binding. The new family is not the old symbolic illustrations or atomic pairs.
closure_test: Satisfied: versioned constructor, exact native packets, separate GT and independent semantic verification exist.
Satisfied: independently controlled visual and fault changes alter complete repair sets; preserving controls and ID replicates are implemented.
Satisfied for the declared scope: atomic, no-image, oracle and multimodal conditions are present and the strong shallow result is disclosed.
The utility of the central interface contribution still depends on BA-004's joint-condition analysis; this closure does not promise acceptance.

issues.summary: Matched changing/preserving controls, public-ID randomization and legal shallow baselines are implemented; the fired shortcut gate is honestly retained.

evidence.finding: Independent randomization domains and fixed structural serialization accompany target/distractor and distractor/distractor label transpositions. Fault partners differ in one missing-list element.
Read-only audit passed complete-answer controls, mapping-back equivariance, and 336 unique PNG intervention pairs with exactly two changed label rectangles.
Pixel baselines use legal crops, generic font calibration and simple foreground descriptors; they do not read capture labels, source meshes or gold.
Independent recomputation matches 91.228070% held-out silhouette micro and 78.290909% group macro. Its both-correct and All-six micro scores also equal 91.228070%. The paper reports the fired gate.
The ordinary adapter payload contains native text and image bytes, not source/arm identities or GT. Oracle binding is separately declared.

issues.why_it_matters: The required relevant/preserving comparisons now exist, legal shallow performance is measured, and claims are narrowed instead of hiding the result. Evaluator-private means excluded from allowed model input, not cryptographically secret or unreleased gold.
closure_test: Satisfied: native pixels and text are matched across the intended controls and dependence is retained.
Satisfied: ID and location rules, appearance/silhouette rules and a privileged oracle are separately reported.
Satisfied: the 0.80 gate fires without task reselection and hard-vision claims are removed.
Keep future model adapters closed-book; repository gold or cross-condition lookup must not become model evidence.

issues.summary: Sampling, exclusion and grouped holdout are now explicit and checked, with appropriately limited finite-resource claims.

evidence.finding: Census and screens, contributor/design/topology grouping before search, overlap/design deduplication and bounded-search outcomes are recorded.
Selected descendant instance sets, induced edges, disjoint same-source selections and source/contributor/design/template split boundaries pass independent checks.
The paper identifies 10 held-out dependence groups, the unattained 25-group precision illustration, gold-conditioned challenge selection and finite-source scope.

issues.why_it_matters: The old source-count generalization claim is replaced by actual construction grouping and a limited estimand. Repeated observations are no longer treated as additional independent constructions.
closure_test: Satisfied: retain census and exclusions, freeze groups before search, and keep all related views and duplicates within split.
Satisfied: demonstrate relevant topology and solution variation, not only source decoration.
Satisfied: report insufficient group precision and avoid broad unseen-design population inference.

issues.summary: Semantic scoring and native execution are repaired, but the central interface study still lacks task-aligned joint estimands, implemented cross-condition paired contrasts, and qualification-to-analysis integration.

evidence.finding: The former missing semantic scorer is now implemented and passes focused adversarial/equivalence tests. This part of the prior issue is closed.
The remaining contribution is the binding/optimization interface, asking whether isolated binding and oracle repair predict combined success, with paired group effects and full/qualified reporting.
Pairing is only among intervention cells within one condition. repair_given_binding conditions on the multimodal response's own binding, not isolated atomic and oracle success for the same item.

Configurations are independently summarized; there is no atomic/oracle/multimodal task join, joint success contingency, or cross-condition contrast computation. Group values permit additional paired-difference computation and raw receipts permit joint analysis, but neither readout is implemented here.
The decomposition schema reserves marginal atomic, no-image and oracle columns plus within-multimodal conditional repair, not the joint isolated-competence event.
Qualification produces construction decisions, but study.analyze has no qualification input or qualified-subset branch. portable.py:43-57 does not bind a qualification-derived eligibility artifact.

An in-memory synthetic counterexample passed: two groups with two constructions each and all twelve cells yield identical complete current metrics for atomic, oracle and multimodal conditions, while multimodal failure conditional on both isolated conditions being correct is 0/24 versus 24/24. No synthetic receipt or empirical report was written.

issues.why_it_matters: Marginal isolated accuracy and within-condition intervention consistency cannot determine whether the same items are solved separately but fail when combined. The paper's narrowed scientific contribution centers on precisely this interface. Cautious language avoids a false causal assertion but does not supply the missing diagnostic. The matched data design can support it without new collection; the released analysis is not yet sufficient. Competent hypothetical human review also need not produce an all-qualified subset.
closure_test: Freeze an explicit task-aligned joint estimand, such as joint contingency counts and P(multimodal exact failure | atomic binding correct AND oracle repair exact), with eligible denominators and an operational, noncausal interpretation. An equivalent justified estimand is acceptable; products of marginal accuracies are not substitutes.

Join compatible model/run locks on the same task, replicate and cell. Implement paired multimodal-minus-oracle repair and multimodal-minus-atomic binding effects using aligned groups. Freeze weighting, empty-group policy and failure handling, and jointly resample complete groups with shared anchors and both ID replicates retained.

Bind validated construction qualification to one common subset across conditions; report both full and qualified results. Distinguish pending and rejected qualification and leave empty qualified/jointly competent estimates undefined.

Add synthetic tests for aligned versus disjoint competence, zero joint eligibility, one missing condition, incompatible locks and construction-wide exclusions. No-exclusion analysis must reproduce existing full-set scores.
Update the manuscript and released schema with the joint/paired readout. No new task family, favorable effect, significant difference, paid call or fabricated human/model evidence is required.

issues.summary: The paper is within the content limit and now visually centers its actual primary task.

evidence.finding: Read-only validation and direct PDF inspection confirm six content pages and references on page 7. The supplement has six pages.
Both main figures show the current visual-repair task; GT and source context are explicitly outside model input.
Checks current task provenance, actual example GT, 147 blank result cells, style assets, resolved citations and content-page limit. Read-only execution passed.
Example native packet, image, source hashes and complete optimum sets match the displayed primary figures.

issues.why_it_matters: The old ten-content-page and nonprimary-figure mismatch is resolved. Small embedded labels in the factorial figure remain a readability limitation, not the former major presentation defect.
closure_test: Satisfied: main content is at most eight pages and references are separate.
Satisfied: primary figures display an actual input, required output and interventions with traceable GT.
Satisfied: historical atomic and symbolic-example counts are not pooled into the new benchmark.

issues.summary: Nonzero adapter exits and timeouts discard available raw diagnostic output.

evidence.finding: The subprocess captures stdout/stderr, but nonzero exits retain only a null response and adapter_exit_N; timeouts retain only the exception class, discarding available partial streams.
An ephemeral mocked subprocess returning code 1 with both stdout and stderr produced a receipt with neither stream retained. No actual adapter/model executed and no receipt file was written.

issues.why_it_matters: The failed slot remains in the denominator, so current scores are not biased by this defect. However, advertised raw-output retention and diagnosis of transport versus generation failures are weakened.
closure_test: Retain raw stdout/stderr, exit status and available partial timeout output in versioned diagnostic fields while preserving unsuccessful attempt status.
Add mocked nonzero-exit and timeout tests without model calls. Do not introduce successful-only retries.

residual_limitations: The scientific contribution is a narrow controlled visual-to-symbolic interface, not a new graph optimization method, difficult perception benchmark, hidden-topology inference task, or physical repair certificate.
Silhouette plus exact search is strong and equally successful on individual, paired and All-six scores; its 91.23% micro result is disclosed and is not itself the rejection reason.
Ten held-out groups provide finite-source sensitivity only. Gold-conditioned selection, repeated part types and undetected design similarities limit generalization.
Of 1008 dependent observations, 598 have one optimum and 802 have cost two or three. Maximum complexity values are not typical-case counts or independent sample sizes.
Public CAD and released evaluator gold create contamination/lookup risks, not demonstrated leakage in the inspected native input path. Future model adapters must remain closed-book.
Human-visible uniqueness and qualification outcomes remain conditional. Machine checks and sampled image inspection do not establish universal answerability.
The factorial figure's embedded labels are small at print size, although larger bound-ID and solution annotations convey the comparison.
LEGO-Puzzles v4 adds an explicit planning set. Updating the cited v3 discussion would improve currency without removing the specific binding/fault/all-optima distinction.
Only targeted read-only validations were rerun; recorded constructor, TypeScript, browser and capture validation was inspected rather than reexecuted.
acceptance_rationale: Not accepted on this snapshot. The revised family, matched controls, semantic scorer, construction grouping and primary-task presentation resolve most round01 concerns. One central major gap remains: the implemented condition summaries cannot distinguish isolated competence from joint success on the same instances. A synthetic counterexample demonstrates identical complete current reports with 0% versus 100% multimodal failure among jointly competent items. The matched experimental design already supports a repair through explicit joint estimands, aligned paired contrasts and qualification-aware analysis. No favorable empirical result or additional task family is required. The high legal silhouette score, blank model cells and absent real human/model collection are not rejection grounds under the stated assumption.

minimal_change_set.change: Specify and implement task-aligned joint isolated-competence/combined-success counts and an operational conditional interface failure estimand, plus shared-group paired condition effects, retaining all failure and empty-eligibility cases.

Bind construction qualification and common condition membership into full/qualified analysis; add counterexample, empty-set, missing-condition, lock-compatibility and exclusion regression tests, and update the manuscript's analysis contract.
Preserve raw diagnostic streams on failed adapter attempts without changing denominators or retry policy.
